records.question: Does UAPI imply WHM/root access?
records.finding: No. UAPI addresses cPanel account features; WHM Transfer Tool has separately documented root or sudo/su requirements.
records.revisit_trigger: Before implementing a new WHM operation or when cPanel changes API behavior

records.question: Can a cPanel account always accept remote DB access?
records.finding: No. Provider feature configuration can disable Remote Database Access; discover and test per host.
records.revisit_trigger: Before designing remote DB setup UX or claiming support

records.question: Which initial stack best supports web/API reuse, adapters, and local proof?
records.finding: Estimated weighted evaluation favors React/TypeScript + NestJS modular monolith + PostgreSQL/BullMQ/Redis; local SQLite is a constrained prototype only.
records.revisit_trigger: If install/resource measurements or security review contradict the ADR

records.question: Which MFA and account-recovery properties should guide ORBICORE auth design?
records.finding: NIST SP 800-63B 4th Revision says OTP manual entry is not phishing-resistant, saved recovery codes must be at least 64 bits and stored hashed/consumed once, and recovery always triggers notification. RFC 6238 recommends a 30-second TOTP step and forbids accepting an OTP a second time after successful validation. SimpleWebAuthn documents one-time challenge persistence and credential ID/public key/counter storage for WebAuthn. This repo implements an encrypted TOTP compatibility fallback only; no NIST assurance or WebAuthn support is claimed.
records.revisit_trigger: Before enabling provider credentials, complete WebAuthn/passkey, verified notification contacts and delivery, and deployment key/recovery controls; recheck current standards and library APIs.
